page.layout: One printed page: a title line at the top; below it a table of contents (Caput | Pag.) with four lines; then a heading in spaced capitals with a second line; then a list of three numbered lines with a large initial D and page numbers at right; a woodcut ornament in the middle (not text); a catchword at the lower right. Text runs from top to bottom in one column.

page.notes: The large initial D in line I is a woodcut initial joined to "E apparatu" as printed ("DE apparatu"). The page numbers at the right are printed in old-style figures: 606, 618, 627, 632, 653, 663, 671. The woodcut ornament between the list and the catchword is not transcribed. Faint Google watermark at the lower right is not transcribed. The catchword "SYN-" is printed at the lower right.
